glosses: to puzzle, perplex, baffle, bewilder (somebody); to afflict by being complicated, contradictory, or otherwise difficult to understand

examples.text: It confused me when I went to the office and nobody was there, but then I realised it was Sunday.
"What confuses me is how other insurance companies knew about it," said Zhang, a 26-year-old government employee from Shandong.

President Donald Trump’s offer to most federal employees to resign now and be paid through September stunned the workers who received it – angering some, confusing many and raising questions about whether the offer is even legal.

glosses: To mix up, muddle up (one thing with another); to mistake (one thing for another).

examples.text: People who say "hola" to Italians are confusing Italian with Spanish.
